title: Neon tech
line: Deep black-blue, thin glowing lines and data drawn as light: waveforms, signals, scans. One cyan, one magenta for what gets cut or flagged.

beats.visual: A cyan waveform draws on left to right over a faint perspective grid; flat runs show the pauses.
A scan line sweeps; each pause lights up magenta with its length above it.
The magenta runs collapse and the speech closes up; minus 3.1 seconds counts up below.

beats.say: Tighter, without a single cut by hand.
beats.visual: The tight waveform rests and glows; the counter holds.
